summary: The global marketing team is executing a China-first SEO/AI-search push around Asia Star and the newly launched Intelligent China program, while closing out the knowledge website redesign and resolving an Outlook lockout that has briefly stalled team access.
summaryDetail: The most urgent item is the Outlook account lockout: stale credentials across laptops, phones and home devices need to be cleared and CKGSB must confirm the backend unlock before normal workflow resumes. The strategic priority is the China-first visibility push agreed at the June 30 sync—Asia Star and Intelligent China lead, US partner programs (Stanford, Columbia, Berkeley) are on hold for the first quarter—with Joseph's audience/prompt document and Asia Star participant/CRM profiling feeding the SEO work, and the Intelligent China webpage needing to go live and start drawing traffic. On the knowledge website, the team has settled on keeping the current design with improved menu categorization, dispersing videos by topic, adding BCI/BSI index banners and section frame lines, and no stock ticker; Joseph still owes the HTML concept file and a 30-minute feedback session must be booked. Also pending: a brief on the Google Ads conversion tracking setup ahead of any audit, and the English obituary for Professor Jon Liao, which TIAN Xuefang must finalize and post.
